# Nano Banana 2

> Nano Banana 2 is Google's new state-of-the-art image generation and editing model



## Overview

- **Endpoint**: `https://fal.run/fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit`
- **Model ID**: `fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit`
- **Category**: image-to-image
- **Kind**: inference


## Pricing

Your request will cost **$0.08** per image. For **$1.00**, you can run this model **12** times. 2K and 4K outputs will be charged at **1.5** times and **2** times the standard rate, respectively. 0.5K (512px) resolution outputs will be charged at **0.75** times the standard rate. If web search is used, an additional **$0.015** will be charged. If high thinking is used, an additional **$0.002** will be charged. **Note: Pricing is subject to change.**

For more details, see [fal.ai pricing](https://fal.ai/pricing).

## API Information

This model can be used via our HTTP API or more conveniently via our client libraries.
See the input and output schema below, as well as the usage examples.


### Input Schema

The API accepts the following input parameters:


- **`prompt`** (`string`, _required_):
  The prompt for image editing.
  - Examples: "make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline"

- **`image_urls`** (`list<string>`, _optional_):
  The URLs of the images to use for image-to-image generation or image editing. Optional when at least one of `video_url`, `audio_url`, or `pdf_url` is provided.
  - Array of string
  - Examples: ["https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_inputs/nano-banana-edit-input.png","https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_inputs/nano-banana-edit-input-2.png"]

- **`history`** (`list<GeminiVideoMessage>`, _optional_):
  Previous native Gemini turns, including original parts and thought signatures from conversations. The current prompt starts a new user turn.
  - Array of GeminiVideoMessage

- **`context`** (`list<GeminiTextPart | GeminiImagePart | GeminiDocumentPart | GeminiVideoPart | GeminiSignaturePart>`, _optional_):
  Ordered text, image, PDF, UTF-8 text-file or video parts appended to the current prompt. Original media bytes are preserved; images count toward the total 14-reference limit.
  - Array of GeminiTextPart | GeminiImagePart | GeminiDocumentPart | GeminiVideoPart | GeminiSignaturePart

- **`return_history`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  Return reusable native conversations with original image parts and provider thought signatures. Uses a native provider. Each generated conversation is independent; send its messages as history for the next turn.
  - Default: `false`

- **`thinking_level`** (`Enum`, _optional_):
  Controls thinking effort ('minimal' or 'high') and requests thought summaries. Omit to use the provider default ('minimal'); thinking cannot be disabled.
  - Options: `"minimal"`, `"high"`

- **`include_thoughts`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  Whether to include thought summaries. Omit to preserve the existing behavior: an explicit thinking_level requests summaries. Set limit_generations=false to return summary text in description. This does not disable thinking or return intermediate thought images.

- **`temperature`** (`float`, _optional_):
  Sampling temperature. Omit to use the provider default of 1. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.
  - Range: `0` to `2`

- **`top_p`** (`float`, _optional_):
  Nucleus sampling probability. Omit to use the provider default of 0.95. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.
  - Range: `0` to `1`

- **`max_output_tokens`** (`integer`, _optional_):
  Maximum output tokens for the generation. Omit to retain the provider default. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.
  - Range: `1` to `32768`

- **`num_images`** (`integer`, _optional_):
  The number of images to generate. Default value: `1`
  - Default: `1`
  - Range: `1` to `4`

- **`seed`** (`integer`, _optional_):
  The seed for the random number generator.

- **`aspect_ratio`** (`Enum`, _optional_):
  The aspect ratio of the generated image. Supports extreme ratios: 4:1, 1:4, 8:1, 1:8. Default value: `auto`
  - Default: `"auto"`
  - Options: `"auto"`, `"21:9"`, `"16:9"`, `"3:2"`, `"4:3"`, `"5:4"`, `"1:1"`, `"4:5"`, `"3:4"`, `"2:3"`, `"9:16"`, `"4:1"`, `"1:4"`, `"8:1"`, `"1:8"`

- **`output_format`** (`OutputFormatEnum`, _optional_):
  The format of the generated image. Default value: `"png"`
  - Default: `"png"`
  - Options: `"jpeg"`, `"png"`, `"webp"`

- **`safety_tolerance`** (`SafetyToleranceEnum`, _optional_):
  The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict. Default value: `"4"`
  - Default: `"4"`
  - Options: `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"4"`, `"5"`, `"6"`

- **`sync_mode`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
  - Default: `false`

- **`system_prompt`** (`string`, _optional_):
  Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers). Default value: `""`
  - Default: `""`

- **`resolution`** (`ResolutionEnum`, _optional_):
  The resolution of the image to generate. Default value: `"1K"`
  - Default: `"1K"`
  - Options: `"0.5K"`, `"1K"`, `"2K"`, `"4K"`

- **`video_url`** (`string`, _optional_):
  Optional video to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL to a video file (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB) or a YouTube URL (passed through to the model without downloading).

- **`audio_url`** (`string`, _optional_):
  Optional audio file to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB).

- **`pdf_url`** (`string`, _optional_):
  Optional PDF document to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB).

- **`limit_generations`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate and ignore any intermediate images generated by the model. This may affect generation quality. Default value: `true`
  - Default: `true`

- **`enable_web_search`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.
  - Default: `false`

- **`enable_image_search`** (`boolean`, _optional_):
  Ground image generation with Google Image Search. Can be combined with enable_web_search; source attribution is returned in grounding_metadata. Uses direct Google or Vertex APIs.
  - Default: `false`



**Required Parameters Example**:

```json
{
  "prompt": "make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline"
}
```

**Full Example**:

```json
{
  "prompt": "make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline",
  "image_urls": [
    "https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_inputs/nano-banana-edit-input.png",
    "https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_inputs/nano-banana-edit-input-2.png"
  ],
  "history": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [
        {
          "type": "",
          "text": ""
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "context": [
    {
      "type": "",
      "text": ""
    }
  ],
  "num_images": 1,
  "aspect_ratio": "auto",
  "output_format": "png",
  "safety_tolerance": "4",
  "resolution": "1K",
  "limit_generations": true
}
```


### Output Schema

The API returns the following output format:

- **`images`** (`list<ImageFile>`, _required_):
  The edited images.
  - Array of ImageFile
  - Examples: [{"file_name":"nano-banana-2-edit-output.png","content_type":"image/png","url":"https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_outputs/nano-banana-2-edit-output.png"}]

- **`description`** (`string`, _required_):
  The description of the generated images.

- **`conversations`** (`list<GeminiConversation>`, _optional_):
  Reusable per-generation conversations, populated only when return_history is true. Retain every part and thought signature when continuing a conversation.
  - Array of GeminiConversation

- **`grounding_metadata`** (`list<object>`, _optional_):
  Provider grounding metadata for the generated images, including search queries, source pages and image-source attribution when available.
  - Array of object



**Example Response**:

```json
{
  "images": [
    {
      "file_name": "nano-banana-2-edit-output.png",
      "content_type": "image/png",
      "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_outputs/nano-banana-2-edit-output.png"
    }
  ],
  "description": "",
  "conversations": [
    {
      "messages": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "parts": [
            {
              "type": "",
              "text": ""
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```


## Usage Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://fal.run/fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit \
  --header "Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
     "prompt": "make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline"
   }'
```

### Python

Ensure you have the Python client installed:

```bash
pip install fal-client
```

Then use the API client to make requests:

```python
import fal_client

def on_queue_update(update):
    if isinstance(update, fal_client.InProgress):
        for log in update.logs:
           print(log["message"])

result = fal_client.subscribe(
    "fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit",
    arguments={
        "prompt": "make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline"
    },
    with_logs=True,
    on_queue_update=on_queue_update,
)
print(result)
```

### JavaScript

```bash
npm install --save @fal-ai/client
```

Then use the API client to make requests:

import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";

const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit", {

  },
  logs: true,
  onQueueUpdate: (update) => {
    if (update.status === "IN_PROGRESS") {
      update.logs.map((log) => log.message).forEach(console.log);
    }
  },
});

console.log(result.requestId);

image size. Use get_asset for a fresh download link when an earlier link has
expired. How the tasks fit together: https://docs.atlas.worldlabs.ai/how-to-use-atlas.md

**Source:** https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit/llms.txt (HTTP 200, the first URL worked, so I did not fetch the fallbacks).

**(1) Pricing**
- Base: **$0.08 per output image** at 1K, the default.
- 0.5K (512px): 0.75x, about $0.06.
- 2K: 1.5x, about $0.12.
- 4K: 2x, about $0.16.
- Extra charges: web search (`enable_web_search`) adds **$0.015**. High thinking (`thinking_level: "high"`) adds **$0.002**.
- The page says pricing is subject to change.

**(2) Input schema**
- `prompt` (string, required).
- `image_urls` (list of strings, optional): the input image URLs. The page does not say whether `data:` URIs work for this field. It does say video, audio, and PDF inputs accept http(s) or data URLs, but gives no such statement for images, so this needs a test call.
- `num_images` (integer, 1 to 4, default 1).
- `aspect_ratio` (default `"auto"`): `auto`, `21:9`, `16:9`, `3:2`, `4:3`, `5:4`, `1:1`, `4:5`, `3:4`, `2:3`, `9:16`, `4:1`, `1:4`, `8:1`, `1:8`.
- `resolution` (default `"1K"`): `0.5K`, `1K`, `2K`, `4K`.
- `output_format` (default `"png"`): `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`.
- `sync_mode` (boolean, default `false`). When true, the output is returned as a data URI and is not kept in request history.
- Other optional fields: `seed`, `safety_tolerance` ("1" to "6", default "4"), `system_prompt`, `enable_web_search`, `enable_image_search`, `thinking_level` (`minimal` or `high`), `limit_generations` (default `true`), `history`, `context`, `return_history`.

**(3) Maximum input images**
- The page sets a **total limit of 14 reference images**. It says images in `context` count toward that limit. It does not give a separate maximum for `image_urls`, so the 14 limit is the best available figure.

**(4) Response format**
- JSON with `images`, a list of objects with `file_name`, `content_type`, and `url`. The output image URLs are at `images[i].url`. An example URL is on storage.googleapis.com.
- Also returned: `description` (string), plus optional `conversations` (when `return_history` is true) and `grounding_metadata` (when search is used).
